# ADR-001: Legacy ADR location

## Status

accepted

## Context

This file lives under `docs/adr/` (singular) — an older convention.

## Decision

Keep both `docs/adr/` and `docs/adrs/` until migration completes.

## Consequences

DOC-005's pre-fill must list both directories.
